numinance.annotations.v1.FieldAnnotation.description:
FieldAnnotations carries lifecycle and sensitivity metadata for one field.
 Set it through the `field` field option.

deprecatedIn.description:
deprecated_in is the strict x.y.z spec version in which the field was
 deprecated, or empty when it is not deprecated.

hostOnly.description:
host_only marks a types.v1.Reference field of a port request that only
 the host may resolve: HostService.ResolveReference refuses a reference equal
 to the value of such a field, even when the same value also sits in a field
 that is not host-only, and the mark applies to every Reference nested under
 a marked message-typed field. Allowed on a Reference field, or a wrapper of
 References, in a numinance.ports.* file only (annotation lint
 HOST_ONLY_INVALID). Added by numinance-spec/rfcs/0001-host-only-field-annotation.md.

replacedBy.description: replaced_by names the field or RPC that supersedes a deprecated field.

resourceName.description:
resource_name marks a string or repeated string field of a port request whose values name resources the call
 touches (a repository, an environment, an artifact), in the spelling a grant's resource scope uses. The Engine
 reads the marks from the descriptor of the RPC's input and derives the policy input's action.resource_scope from
 the request message itself, never from a value the caller states beside it; a marked value outside the acting
 grant's resource scope is denied. The mark applies to a marked field at any depth of the input message, through
 singular, repeated, group and map-value message fields. A request that names no resource through a marked field is
 denied, and so is a request with an unknown field, so never mark an optional filter field: mark only fields a call
 must name. An empty marked string names nothing and is never defaulted to an implicit resource. Allowed on a string
 or repeated string field of a message that an RPC input reaches, in a numinance.ports.* file only (annotation lint
 RESOURCE_NAME_INVALID). Added by numinance-spec/rfcs/0002-resource-name-field-annotation.md.

sensitive.description:
sensitive marks a field that may hold a secret or personal data. It is
 redacted in logs and never copied into evidence in clear text.

since.description:
since is the strict x.y.z spec version in which the field was introduced.
 Required on every field added after 1.0.0.

numinance.annotations.v1.FieldAnnotation.title: Field Annotations
